{{Top|leg}}
The '''X/ATM-44 thruster component''' was produced by [[Vokoff-Strood/Legends|Vokoff-Strood]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Originally designed for Vokoff-Strood [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], it was later adapted for use in [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to increase their maximum speed.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' {{1st}}
